metadata.name: Airtame Emergency Alert
metadata.description: Triggers and clears Airtame Emergency Alerts via the Airtame Cloud public emergency-alerts API. Use this module to display emergency signage on Airtame screens in response to KNX/Gira events.

parameter.name: api_endpoint
parameter.description: Airtame Emergency Alerts endpoint. Must be HTTPS.

parameter.name: api_key
parameter.description: Airtame Cloud API key (stored as Basic-auth password).

parameter.name: alert_id_prefix
parameter.description: Prefix used to generate unique alert IDs.

parameter.name: default_description
parameter.default: Emergency alert triggered from Gira HomeServer.

parameter.name: debounce_ms
parameter.description: Minimum interval between accepted rising edges.

input.name: trigger
input.description: Rising edge sends an Initiated alert.

input.name: clear
input.description: Rising edge sends a Resolved alert for the active id.

output.name: active
output.description: True while the last initiated alert has not been resolved.

output.name: success_pulse
output.description: Pulses true for one cycle after a successful 2xx response.

output.name: error_pulse
output.description: Pulses true for one cycle on validation or HTTP failure.

output.name: last_status_code
output.description: HTTP status code from the last request (0 = transport error).

output.name: last_message
output.description: Short human-readable result or error message.

output.name: last_alert_id
output.description: ID assigned to the last initiated alert.
